newsitem.title: USA: Consolidated Products seeks NYSE listing.
newsitem.headline: Consolidated Products seeks NYSE listing.

text.p: Consolidated Products Inc, the parent company of Steak n Shake restaurants, said Tuesday it applied to list its common stock on the New York Stock Exchange.
The company said it expects its shares will begin trading on the NYSE on or about November 19, 1996. The company's stock has traded in the NASDAQ market for the past 48 years.

Consolidated said its five-year plan, from fiscal 1997 to fiscal 2001, is for an annual increase in the number of company-operated Steak n Shake restaurants of at least 20 percent. In addition, the company said it intends to expand its franchise system.
The plan would result in more than 500 Steak n Shake restaurants by the end of 2001, with 400 of those company-operated, Consolidated said.
